translations.name: WomenRising Workforce Development (Jersey City)
translations.description: WomenRising Workforce Development in Jersey City helps women with job training. No income test is published. Contact them by phone or email, Monday to Friday 9:30am-4:30pm. Call 201-333-5700 ext. 560. It can take days to weeks.
translations.website_description: Find help with jobs and training.
